problem: Determine whether the unchanged SPCX cash-open gap-reversal mechanism retains usable opportunity density and resolved lifecycle economics on prospectively captured venue evidence.

prospective_prefix.unscorable_reason: Capture began after the prior eligible Thursday cash close, so Friday could not be evaluated without backfilling or fabricating the missing prior close.

interpretation.what_is_supported: The unchanged prospective rule was reconstructed from exact public-trade OHLC and produced no entry in the single fully scorable cash-open session.
interpretation.what_is_not_supported: One scorable session cannot validate or reject the historical approximately 3.94 trades-per-week development estimate and provides no lifecycle profitability evidence.
failure_modes: future entry lifecycles may overlap unresolved mark or L2 bars
the historical development edge may be unstable or outlier-dependent
the prospective signal may be too sparse to restore portfolio opportunity density
live fees, slippage, or gaps may exceed the frozen development contract

minimum_evidence.next_update: At least one attributable frozen entry or five fully scorable cash-open sessions, whichever occurs first.
minimum_evidence.live_change_review: Require resolved entry and full lifecycle paths, exact fees/funding/slippage, both-side accounting, positive stress net and largest-winner-removed net over a predeclared compatible window. A single lifecycle is diagnostic only.
minimum_evidence.frequency_falsifier: Update the approximately 3.94 trades-per-week expectation downward if a materially longer fully scorable prospective window produces substantially fewer entries.
minimum_evidence.economic_falsifier: Reject the unchanged route if resolved prospective lifecycles are negative after exact costs or remain dependent on one largest winner.
